A.note: A covers the full flow (organization, results, issues, 2027 plan, requests to the district office), and its numbers add up: the program totals come to 1,420 and the quarterly figures match. It is short on budget detail, and the deck uses a single tone and repeats the same layout, which makes it feel somewhat bland.

B.note: B is very thorough for a district office report. It includes budget spending, three standout examples, issues to fix, a quarterly roadmap, the required budget, and requests for help, and the totals are consistent (for example, 405 + 135 = 540). The charts, icons and cards are varied and well organized. Some tables and chart labels are small enough to be hard to read on screen.
